title: sec: receive_from_peer() accepts unauthenticated DAO messages
description: DaoBackboneBridge::receive_from_peer() at line 548 accepts any DaoBackboneMessage without validating origin matches OSCORE identity, checking RPL instance, or enforcing timestamp freshness. Add authentication validation before storing routes.
close_reason: Fixed: Added authentication validation to receive_from_peer() - validates RPL instance ID, rejects self-origin, enforces timestamp freshness (300s), and requires OSCORE-authenticated sender to match claimed origin. Added 6 tests for security validation.
